overview: Google dominated the day: Sundar Pichai announced Gemini 4 Carbon, two weeks after Argon, and Alphabet Q3 results with Cloud up 103%. One reposted claim said GOOGL fell 8% on an earnings miss, which conflicts with Pichai's upbeat numbers. Also notable: Michael Burry's warning on Anthropic's IPO filing, Shopify's Fall Edition, which includes the Shop.app to Shop.com move, and Tesla's Robotaxi expansion in Houston. Political posts were skipped.

top_items.title: sundarpichai - Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis v5.0 at 59, two weeks after Argon; cyber defenders get it first

burrytracker - Burry says Anthropic's IPO filing shows $537B in compute obligations against ~$65B revenue, calling AI 'catastrophically vulnerable'
tobi - Shopify's Fall 2026 Edition is out: Shop.app becomes Shop.com and Campaign Autopilot opens to all merchants
elonmusk - Tesla is expanding its Cybercab/Robotaxi service area across Houston, per a Houston police post Musk amplified
brian_armstrong - Armstrong pitches stablecoins plus x402 for per-article micropayments made by AI agents instead of subscriptions
elonmusk - Neuralink shares early speech-restoration data, saying it enables speech-to-text and voice at conversational rates
